caption: The drawing depicts a single elaborate dress without a wearer, shown prominently in the foreground and accompanied by a smaller line sketch of the same dress from the back at the upper right. The dress is depicted in shades of pale cream and beige, with shimmery, satiny texture created by flowing lines and highlights. The bodice features a high lace collar and a pointed, fitted waist, with ornamental trim, lace, and jewel-like detailing along the neckline, shoulders, and cuffs. The long sleeves are fitted and end in decorated cuffs. The skirt is voluminous, bell-shaped, and extends outward with folds and shadows to suggest heavy, luxurious fabric. The line sketch in the background outlines the back of the dress, showing additional details such as seams and the continuation of the full skirt. The background is a plain, light beige, and below the foreground dress on the right, the name "Hager" is written.
title: Wedding Dress
